description: JUNGLE. House, disco, and funk. This album is ode to all things that I love and am inspired by. I love nature, I love funky beats, I love to dance, and I love my creative ass friends. This is a culmination of all those things.
credits:
Dedicated to my amazing friends. You guys continue to inspire me.

Artwork by Jess Doughty (@theycallmedewy)
